entries.message: This update includes resolve code scanning alerts (#27), close remaining stack trace exposure (#28), and cut the cost of the Movies, Stats and restore screens.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tweak: This update includes resolve code scanning alerts (#27), close remaining stack trace exposure (#28), and cut the cost of the Movies, Stats and restore screens.
Tweak: Keep stack traces out of admin-visible diagnostics and harden provider parsing and logging against CodeQL findings.
Tweak: Normalize caught provider, credential, outbound, and watchlist errors before they can reach API responses.

Tweak: Movies pages now answer from a cached projection instead of re-deriving the whole library on every request: pages 1, 5 and 10 went from about 60ms to under 1ms on a 90,000-row library, and the page number no longer changes the cost

Tweak: The Stats page no longer downloads every period's report just to display one; it receives the totals, a short list of the available years and months, and only the report being viewed, fetching a different period when you pick one

Tweak: A completed restore's full result and log are stored separately from the live status row, so the restore screen stops re-downloading the entire report on every poll while still showing the whole log
Tweak: Library reads are backed by new database indexes covering season and title lookups, provider ids and recent ordering, with planner statistics refreshed once after they are created
Tweak: Poster and backdrop paths are stored as their own columns on the metadata cache, so artwork no longer requires parsing the full details blob
Tweak: Versioned assets are now cached for a year while the app entry page and manifest keep revalidating, so a new release is still picked up immediately

entries.message: This update includes sync up next and watched state across providers and prevent stale media renders and harden sync performance.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tweak: This update includes sync up next and watched state across providers and prevent stale media renders and harden sync performance.

Tweak: Keep Up Next and watched state aligned across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin, repair newly available provider episodes, preserve accurate progress, restore episode titles, and polish refresh/menu controls.
Tweak: Prevent stale media detail responses from repainting the dashboard after rapid navigation.
Tweak: Keep show and movie detail hydration, watch actions, and provider-derived state consistent during asynchronous loads.
Tweak: Improve scheduler, live-session, and incremental provider-sync behavior for reliable updates.
Tweak: Bound and instrument derived-cache rebuilds and add repeatable large-library performance baselines.
Tweak: Harden response caching, compression, and asset-version handling for safer browser loads.
